steps: lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) for _,h in pairs(p:getHeros()) do local hero=h if hero:getLevel()<xyd.tables.player:heroMaxLev(p.lev) then p:addPartnerExp({item_id=50001005,partner_id=hero:getHeroID(),item_num=100,total_num=p:getBackpack():getItemNumByID(50001005)},function(code,req,reply) if code~=xyd.error.OK or not reply.partner_exp then error('vc-training-failed') end hero:setExp(reply.partner_exp,xyd.tables.player:heroMaxLev(p.lev)) p:getBackpack():setItemNumByID(reply.item_id,reply.total_num) end) end end

lua:local cards={} local function walk(n) if not n:isVisible() then return end if n:getName()=='layout' then table.insert(cards,n) return end for _,c in ipairs(n:getChildren()) do walk(c) end end walk(xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('battle_select_team'):nodeByName('list_layer')) for _,card in ipairs(cards) do local b=card:getCascadeBoundingBox() __vc.tap(b.x+b.width/2,b.y+b.height/2) end

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('battle_win') if not w or w._type~=1 then error('tower-must-use-plain-win') end local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.PET_COMPAIGN) if m.normal.now_floor~=1 or m.normal.max_floor~=1 then error('tower-victory-not-persisted') end

lua:local wm=xyd.WindowManager.get() local w=wm:getWindow('battle_win') local n=w.returnBtn_ if not n then error('vc-no-battle-return') end local b=n:getCascadeBoundingBox() local e={x=b.x+b.width/2,y=b.y+b.height/2} local ls=n._LuaListeners[cc.NODE_TOUCH_EVENT] if type(ls)~='table' then error('vc-no-return-listener') end for _,l in ipairs(ls) do e.name='began' l.listener_(e) e.name='ended' l.listener_(e) end
lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('common_alert') local n=w and w.rightBtn if not n or type(n.callback)~='function' then error('vc-tower-no-confirm') end n.callback({name='ended'})
lua:local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.PET_COMPAIGN) if m.normal.now_floor~=0 or m.normal.max_floor~=1 then error('tower-reset-lost-best') end

lua:local wm=xyd.WindowManager.get() local w=wm:getWindow('pet_sweeping') if w then local n=w:nodeByName('finish_btn') local ls=n._LuaListeners[cc.NODE_TOUCH_EVENT] if type(ls)~='table' then error('vc-tower-finish-listener') end for _,l in ipairs(ls) do l.listener_({name='began'}) l.listener_({name='ended'}) end else local award=wm:getWindow('pet_campaign_award') if not award or not award.isFinishAward then error('vc-tower-no-timer-or-award') end print('vc-tower-stock-auto-callback-completed') end

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('common_alert') if w then if not w.rightBtn or type(w.rightBtn.callback)~='function' then error('vc-tower-finish-confirm') end w.rightBtn.callback({name='ended'}) end

lua:local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.PET_COMPAIGN) if m.normal.now_floor~=1 or m.normal.max_floor~=1 or m.normal.begin_sweep_time~=0 then error('tower-timer-claim') end if not xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('pet_campaign_award') then error('tower-reward-window') end
